mapper.select: SELECT a.answer_option FROM answer a WHERE a.answer_id = ( SELECT qu.answer_id FROM quote qu WHERE qu.question_id = ( SELECT DISTINCT q.question_id FROM question q JOIN category c ON c.category_id = q.category_id OR q.category_id IS NULL JOIN answer a ON q.question_id = a.question_id WHERE c.category_id = #{categoryId} AND q.question LIKE '%고수의%' AND (c.include_common = TRUE OR q.category_id IS NOT NULL) ) AND qu.user_id = #{userId} AND qu.category_id = #{categoryId} )

SELECT DISTINCT q.user_id, ec.category_id, c.category_name, e.expert_id, e.expert_name, e.location, e.gender FROM expert_category ec JOIN expert e ON ec.expert_id = e.expert_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = ec.category_id JOIN quote q ON q.category_id = ec.category_id WHERE c.category_id = #{categoryId} AND q.user_id = #{userId} AND e.location = ( SELECT a.answer_option FROM answer a WHERE a.answer_id = ( SELECT qu.answer_id FROM quote qu WHERE qu.question_id = ( SELECT DISTINCT q.question_id FROM question q JOIN category c ON c.category_id = q.category_id OR q.category_id IS NULL JOIN answer a ON q.question_id = a.question_id WHERE c.category_id = #{categoryId} AND q.question LIKE '지역%' AND (c.include_common = TRUE OR q.category_id IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 1 ) AND qu.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1 ) )
AND e.gender = 'M'
AND e.gender = 'F'
SELECT DISTINCT q.category_id as categoryId, c.category_name as categoryName FROM quote q JOIN category c ON q.category_id = c.category_id where q.user_id = #{userId};

SELECT c.category_name, q.question, a.answer_option, quote.other_answer FROM quote JOIN category c ON c.category_id = quote.category_id JOIN question q ON q.question_id = quote.question_id JOIN answer a ON a.answer_id = quote.answer_id WHERE quote.user_id = #{userId} and quote.category_id = #{categoryId}

SELECT DISTINCT q.user_id, q.category_id, c.category_name FROM quote q JOIN answer a ON q.answer_id = a.answer_id JOIN category c ON q.category_id = c.category_id WHERE q.category_id IN ( SELECT ec.category_id FROM expert_category ec JOIN expert e ON e.expert_id = ec.expert_id WHERE e.expert_id = #{expertId} ) AND q.user_id IN ( SELECT q1.user_id FROM quote q1 JOIN answer a1 ON q1.answer_id = a1.answer_id WHERE q1.question_id = ( SELECT DISTINCT q.question_id FROM question q JOIN category c ON c.category_id = q.category_id OR q.category_id IS NULL JOIN answer a ON q.question_id = a.question_id WHERE q.question LIKE '지역%' AND (c.include_common = TRUE OR q.category_id IS NOT NULL) AND c.category_id IN ( SELECT ec.category_id FROM expert_category ec JOIN expert e ON e.expert_id = ec.expert_id WHERE e.expert_id = #{expertId} ) ) AND a1.answer_option = ( SELECT e.location FROM expert_category ec JOIN expert e ON e.expert_id = ec.expert_id WHERE e.expert_id = #{expertId} ) ) AND q.user_id IN ( SELECT q2.user_id FROM quote q2 JOIN answer a2 ON q2.answer_id = a2.answer_id WHERE q2.question_id = ( SELECT DISTINCT q.question_id FROM question q JOIN category c ON c.category_id = q.category_id OR q.category_id IS NULL JOIN answer a ON q.question_id = a.question_id WHERE q.question LIKE '선호하는%' AND (c.include_common = TRUE OR q.category_id IS NOT NULL) AND c.category_id IN ( SELECT ec.category_id FROM expert_category ec JOIN expert e ON e.expert_id = ec.expert_id WHERE e.expert_id = #{expertId} ) )
AND a2.answer_option IN ('남자', '무관')
AND a2.answer_option IN ('여자', '무관')
)
